question:
Batch 68 CYCLE 2 (cycle 1: no consensus findings; the diff is unchanged) = the publishing kit and law L-t. Law L-t (orchestrator 2026-11-12): a moments package's ONE title and caption travel in the EDL, sealed and gated, and all audience-facing text is in the integrity class. Measured (2026-11-13 17:12, pin 0c68b589, the first full pass): the kit delivered as Telegram 67848 suggested the title 'bitcoin | Pulse Check' and opened its description with 'bitcoin.'. telegram.publish_kit took edl['headline'] or edl['topic'] ('bitcoin'). The EDL carried title 'No single owner controls the bitcoin network' and the sealed caption, which the kit never read. The videos and their captions were not affected.
The change (pipeline/telegram.py, publish_kit only): title = edl['title'] when present (moments pins). The suggested title is that title + ' | Pulse Check' (the kit's existing format), and the description's lead is the sealed caption. When there is no title (story pins), headline / topic exactly as before. If a title is present and the caption is empty, the lead falls back to '<title>.'.
Tests: test_telegram_delivery.test_a_moments_kit_carries_the_sealed_title_and_caption. It FAILS on the old telegram.py ('SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin | Pulse Check') and passes on the fix. test_telegram_delivery + test_review_drop: 41 passed (the story-pin kit test unchanged).
FIND: a moments kit that can still carry a title or caption other than the sealed ones; a change to a story pin's kit; any other audience-facing text in the kit that is not sealed; a test that does not test what it claims. Only state what you can verify from the diff. Reply with the JSON verdict; keep the reasoning short; at most 3 findings.

rejected_findings.issue: Story-pin kit changes: when a story EDL carries a non-empty 'title' field, publish_kit now uses it instead of headline/topic, altering the story-pin kit despite the claim 'story pins exactly as before'.
rejected_findings.evidence:
title = (edl.get("title") or "").strip()        # law L-t: a moments pin's ONE sealed title and caption (17:12: the
    headline = title or (edl.get("headline") or edl.get("topic") or "").strip().rstrip(".")   # kit said 'bitcoin')
rejected_findings.fix: If story EDLs never set 'title', no change; otherwise gate the title branch on a moments marker (e.g. presence of 'caption') or document the behavior. Confidence: 0.6.

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: Caption lead fallback when title present but caption empty/whitespace yields '<title>.' with the title's original punctuation, and the title is not stripped of trailing periods like the headline branch
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.evidence: lead = ((edl.get("caption") or "").strip() if title else "") or f"{headline}." — when title is set and caption is empty, lead = f"{headline}." where headline = title (unstripped of '.'); a title ending in '.' produces a doubled period 'title.. ' in the description lead
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Strip trailing period from title before building lead, e.g. lead = (caption or headline.rstrip('.') + '.').

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: Caption-only-when-title coupling: a moments EDL with a sealed caption but no title field silently drops the caption from the description lead
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.evidence: lead = ((edl.get("caption") or "").strip() if title else "") or f"{headline}." — the caption is only read when title is truthy; an EDL with caption set but title empty/absent falls back to f"{headline}." and the sealed caption never appears
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Read caption independently: lead = (edl.get("caption") or "").strip() or f"{headline}.", or gate on (title or caption).

missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.issue: Test's assertNotIn('SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin', kit) is weaker than it looks and the test does not verify the story-pin path is unchanged
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.evidence: The EDL sets headline=None, topic='bitcoin', so the old code would produce 'SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin | Pulse Check'; assertNotIn('SUGGESTED TITLE: bitcoin') would also pass trivially if the title were, e.g., 'bitcoinx' — but more importantly the test only exercises the moments path; the claim that story-pin kits are unchanged ('test_telegram_delivery + test_review_drop: 41 passed, the story-pin kit test unchanged') is not verified by this new test, and no assertion pins the story-pin behavior (headline/topic, no title) in the diff
missed_in_cycle2_unvoted.fix: Add/keep a story-pin test asserting 'SUGGESTED TITLE: <headline> | Pulse Check' when title is absent, to guard the conditional branch.
